phase: The same comparison as v16 with four seeds instead of one. v16 was void because every interval crossed zero on 74 cells and about twenty purchases per arm; four seeds quadruple the purchase denominator and make the block bootstrap usable, which is what the cell-only interval was missing.
primary: The seventeen answer-key indicators, pooled across four seed blocks and scored with the two-stage bootstrap that resamples blocks before cells.
limitations: Still twelve people. More seeds raise precision for these twelve, not generalisation.
Gate-blocked cells are repaired by the loop and the matrix stays incomplete by construction; the exclusion count is reported per seed.
Three repair rounds, not four - the fourth removed only four cells in v14 and costs as much as the third.
An indicator that finally excludes zero still says only that this cohort moved, not that the published magnitude was reproduced.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Closed pair carried over from v16 (experiments/v17/prompt_v17.md). No new candidate is introduced.
